content_blocks.text: The sun dipped below the horizon, casting long shadows over the old stone walls of the village. The air was thick with the scent of pine and damp earth, a familiar comfort that seemed to whisper secrets from the past. In the center of the village square stood an ancient oak, its gnarled branches reaching towards the fading light. As the last rays of the sun disappeared, a soft breeze rustled through the leaves, and the villagers gathered around the tree, their faces alight with stories of ancestors and legends.
